The

attribute is a boolean attribute that can be added to an element to enable built-in playback controls. If omitted, no controls will be shown.
Note:
Some browsers, such as Safari, may not display a volume control by default even when the

Supporting Multiple Audio Formats
When it comes to audio file types, there are differences in which browsers support which type. To accommodate this, you can use
elements inside the
element and the browser will select the first source that it understands. Here's an example of using multiple
elements for an
element:

interactive.text:
<audio controls>
  <source src="audio.ogg" type="audio/ogg" />
  <source src="audio.wav" type="audio/wav" />
  <source src="audio.mp3" type="audio/mpeg" />
</audio>

c: The browser will first start with the ogg type, and if it can't play the audio, then it'll move down to the next type in the list.
